name: world-countries
title: Countries (ISO 3166-1)
description: ISO 3166-1 country and territory codes: alpha-2, alpha-3 and numeric codes with English and French short names (Unicode CLDR). Includes the user-assigned code XK (Kosovo), which has no official ISO numeric code.

licenses.name: Unicode-3.0
licenses.title: Unicode License v3 (short names from Unicode CLDR)

sources.title: GeoNames countryInfo.txt: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, alpha-3 and numeric codes (CC BY 4.0), retrieved 2026-11-16. Obsolete GeoNames rows without a CLDR short name (CS, AN) omitted. XK (Kosovo) kept as a common user-assigned code with empty numeric_code.
Unicode CLDR (cldr-localenames-full) territories in en and fr: short names (Unicode License v3), retrieved 2026-11-16
ISO 3166 country codes: codes may be used freely in lists and software (ISO confirmation); official browsing platform

fields.name: code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. XK is user-assigned (Kosovo), not an officially assigned ISO 3166-1 code.

fields.name: alpha_3_code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. XKX for Kosovo is user-assigned.

fields.name: numeric_code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 numeric code, zero-padded (004, not 4). Empty for Kosovo, which has none.

fields.name: name
fields.description: English short name from Unicode CLDR (default form).

fields.name: name_fr
fields.description: French short name from Unicode CLDR (default form).
